picks.title: Sony Announces QSSR, a Trimmed Down Version of PSSR That Finally Brings AI Upscaling to Base PS5
picks.headline: Sony Announces QSSR, a Trimmed Down Version of PSSR That Finally Brings AI Upscaling to Base PS5
picks.rationale: Platform-level news: Sony's new lightweight neural upscaler QSSR brings PS5 Pro-style AI upscaling to the whole base-PS5 install base (Wolverine, Ghost of Yotei first), so every PS5 render target can now count on it.
picks.excerpt: Sony's QSSR is a lighter neural upscaler that runs on the base PS5's weaker GPU, extending the PS5 Pro's PSSR pipeline to the whole install base.

picks.title: Introducing the official Unity plugin for Grok Build
picks.headline: Introducing the official Unity plugin for Grok Build
picks.rationale: New official release: Unity now ships a first-party plugin for xAI's Grok Build coding agent, so Unity teams get engine-aware guidance from a third major agent, not only Claude Code and Codex.
picks.excerpt: Unity introduces an official plugin for xAI's Grok Build coding agent, bringing Unity engineering guidance directly into the terminal for AI-assisted game development.

picks.title: UEFN Claude Team Starter Kit v1.84 — an AI dev team for your Fortnite map
picks.headline: UEFN Claude Team Starter Kit v1.84 — an AI dev team for your Fortnite map
picks.rationale: Downloadable release: Claude Code plus Unreal MCP set up as a visible multi-agent team for UEFN map building, with a dashboard and memory carried between maps. Creators can try it right away.
picks.excerpt: A community kit turns Claude Code plus Unreal MCP into a visible multi-agent 'AI dev team' for UEFN map building, with a live dashboard and memory that learns from each shipped map.

picks.title: Twitch Is Using AI To Decide Which Streamers Can Make Money Off Ads
picks.headline: Twitch Is Using AI To Decide Which Streamers Can Make Money Off Ads
picks.rationale: Platform policy change: Twitch now uses AI to classify stream content and decide which creators can earn ad revenue, a direct hit to creators' income.
picks.excerpt: Twitch is now using AI classification of stream content to decide which creators are eligible for ad revenue, drawing pushback from streamers.

picks.title: Sina — a 100% local AI digital human that walks the level and operates Blueprint equipment
picks.headline: Sina — a 100% local AI digital human that walks the level and operates Blueprint equipment
picks.rationale: UE5 plugin that connects a MetaHuman to a local AI brain so it can talk, walk the level and operate Blueprint equipment with no cloud. A hands-on AI-NPC building block.
picks.excerpt: A UE5 plugin links any project to a local AI 'brain' so a MetaHuman can talk, move through the level and operate Blueprint-driven equipment with no cloud AI.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Fx1orSJc.new_action: New release: Unity's official plugin for xAI Grok Build (Oct 1), a different agent and a separate product from the Claude Code (9/13) and Codex (9/18-19) plugins already published.

dedup.note: Re-curation: removed the PocketGamer.biz 'Layer launches AI Playable ad generator' pick because it is a SPONSORED paid guest post (advertorial). Replacement is the Unity Grok Build plugin (Unity official YouTube), marked follow-up to the Unity agent-plugin series: it is a new official release for a different agent (xAI Grok Build), not a re-post of the Claude Code/Codex plugins. Other remaining candidates were rejected: the 80 Level, TheGamer and GamesRadar+ QSSR items are the same story as the IGN pick (cluster c1). The PC Gamer 'spot the DLSS 5' quiz is commentary with no new event. The Wccftech DLSS 4.5-on-Radeon mod continues the DLSS-on-AMD mod story (9/05, 9/29) and is low novelty. The Codex/GPT-6 NPC community tutorial overlaps the Unreal MCP getting-started card (9/19) and would be a third Epic Developer Community card, breaking the per-outlet cap of 2. Cluster c1 (Sony QSSR) kept IGN only. Twitch ad-eligibility AI is a different event from the Twitch stream-coach (9/24) and CEO disclosure-rules (9/29) cards. Sina is a different project from UE Box (10/01). Diversity: 4 outlets (IGN, Unity, Epic Developer Community x2, Aftermath).
